vocabulary.meaning_en: a machine used in the home, like a fridge or washing machine
vocabulary.example: We bought new kitchen appliances.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a box-shaped machine for baking or roasting food
vocabulary.example: The bread is still in the oven.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a machine that heats food very quickly
vocabulary.example: Heat the soup in the microwave for two minutes.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a machine that mixes food into a liquid
vocabulary.example: I make banana milk in the blender.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a container used to boil water
vocabulary.example: Put the kettle on, let's have some tea.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a machine that makes bread brown and crispy
vocabulary.example: The toaster burned my bread again.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a machine that keeps food cold
vocabulary.example: There's some juice in the fridge.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a machine that keeps food frozen
vocabulary.example: Put the ice cream in the freezer.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a machine that washes plates and cups
vocabulary.example: The dishwasher saves us a lot of time.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a machine that washes clothes
vocabulary.example: The washing machine is making a strange noise.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a machine that dries clothes after washing
vocabulary.example: Move the clothes from the washer to the dryer.

vocabulary.meaning_en: an electric machine that cleans floors by sucking up dirt
vocabulary.example: The vacuum cleaner is in the cupboard.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a tool you heat to make clothes smooth
vocabulary.example: Be careful, the iron is still hot.

vocabulary.meaning_en: machines that make sound louder
vocabulary.example: These speakers are too loud.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a mobile phone that works like a small computer
vocabulary.example: She checks her smartphone every five minutes.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a device that puts power into a battery
vocabulary.example: Don't forget your charger if your battery is low.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a speaker that can answer questions and play music when you talk to it
vocabulary.example: The smart speaker told us the weather.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a fridge connected to the internet
vocabulary.example: Our smart fridge shows what food we need to buy.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a small device used to control a TV or machine from a distance
vocabulary.example: Where's the TV remote?

vocabulary.meaning_en: a machine with turning blades that moves air
vocabulary.example: Turn on the fan, it's hot in here.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a machine that makes the air in a room cool
vocabulary.example: In summer, we turn on the air conditioner.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a machine that makes a room warm
vocabulary.example: In winter, we need a heater to stay warm.

vocabulary.meaning_en: completely new and never used before
vocabulary.example: He drove a brand new car out of the shop.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a useful part or function of a device or program
vocabulary.example: This phone has a great camera feature.

vocabulary.meaning_en: by mistake, not on purpose
vocabulary.example: I accidentally deleted the photo.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to join something to a network or another thing
vocabulary.example: Connect your laptop to the Wi-Fi.

vocabulary.meaning_en: new information; to make something more modern
vocabulary.example: The app needs an update.

vocabulary.meaning_en: something that goes very badly wrong
vocabulary.example: The party was a disaster.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to stop a machine working
vocabulary.example: Switch off the lights when you leave.

vocabulary.meaning_en: extremely cold
vocabulary.example: It's freezing outside, wear a coat.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person whose job is to fix machines
vocabulary.example: A technician came to fix the internet.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a box for keeping tools
vocabulary.example: He opened his toolbox and took out a screwdriver.

vocabulary.meaning_en: in the correct way
vocabulary.example: Close the door properly.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to bend your head or body forward to show respect or thanks
vocabulary.example: The actors bowed at the end of the show.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to fix something that is broken
vocabulary.example: Can you repair my bike?

vocabulary.meaning_en: work done to make an old building look new again
vocabulary.example: The kitchen renovation took three months.

vocabulary.meaning_en: pleasant for your body to use or be in
vocabulary.example: This chair is very comfortable.

fine_lines.title: new vs brand new
fine_lines.explanation_ar: new تعني جديد بالنسبة لك أنت، وقد يكون الشيء مستعملاً من قبل (مثل سيارة مستعملة اشتريتها من شخص آخر). brand new تعني جديد تماماً، خرج من المصنع ولم يستخدمه أحد قبلك.

examples.sentence: I bought a new car. It's a 2015 model.
This is my new flat; I moved in last week.
She bought a brand new phone, still in its box.
The hotel has brand new rooms.

fine_lines.title: repair vs renovation
fine_lines.explanation_ar: repair يعني تصليح شيء معطّل ليعود إلى العمل. renovation يعني تجديد المكان أو تغيير شكله ليصبح أحدث وأجمل، حتى لو لم يكن فيه شيء معطّل.

examples.sentence: The house is closed for renovation.

fine_lines.title: comfortable vs cozy
fine_lines.explanation_ar: comfortable تعني مريح من الناحية الجسدية: كرسي مريح لظهرك أو سرير مريح للنوم. cozy تعني فيه دفء وراحة نفسية: مكان صغير هادئ بإضاءة دافئة تشعر فيه بالأمان. قد يكون البيت comfortable بأفضل الأثاث لكنه ليس cozy.

examples.sentence: We sat in a cozy little café on a rainy day.

fine_lines.title: fridge vs freezer
fine_lines.explanation_ar: fridge (الثلاجة) تحفظ الطعام بارداً، أما freezer (الفريزر) فيحفظه مُجمّداً.

examples.sentence: Keep the milk in the fridge.
The chicken is frozen in the freezer.

expressions.example: When Dad saw the scratch on his brand new car, he hit the roof.

expressions.meaning_ar: خطة أو شيء هشّ جداً قد ينهار في أي لحظة
expressions.example: Their business was a house of cards, built on lies.
The food was cold, but at least it was cheap.

expressions.phrase: like a queen / like a king
expressions.example: She sat on the sofa like a queen.
You look tired. I'll put the kettle on.

grammar.title: Past perfect for telling stories in order
grammar.explanation_ar: عند حكي القصص نستخدم الماضي التام (had + التصريف الثالث) لنوضح أن حدثاً وقع وانتهى قبل حدث آخر في الماضي. مع by the time نضع الماضي البسيط للحدث الأحدث، والماضي التام للأقدم.
examples: By the time the fridge started speaking Spanish, Ali had connected it to the neighbour's Wi-Fi.
By the time Omar shouted, Sarah had already switched off the air conditioner.
By the time James arrived, Emma had started typing on her laptop.

grammar.title: Adverbs ending in -ly
grammar.explanation_ar: كثير من الظروف (adverbs) تُصنع بإضافة ly إلى الصفة، وتصف كيف يتم الفعل: proper → properly، accidental → accidentally، loud → loudly، sudden → suddenly.
examples: He showed them how to use the dishwasher properly.

questions.question: You use a ___ to boil water for tea.
"I bought a ___ phone. Nobody used it before me — it was still in the box."
questions.explanation_ar: brand new = جديد تماماً لم يُستخدم أبداً.

questions.question: The washing machine was broken, so we called a technician to ___ it.
A small, warm café with soft lights where you feel relaxed is:
By the time Omar shouted, Sarah ___ the air conditioner.
questions.explanation_ar: إطفاء المكيف حدث أولاً = الماضي التام.

questions.question: "When he saw the bill, he hit the roof." This means he:
Ali connected the fridge to the neighbour's Wi-Fi by mistake. He did it ___.
"Their plan was a house of cards" means the plan was:
questions.explanation_ar: house of cards = شيء هش قد ينهار في أي لحظة.

questions.question: This bed is very ___. My back doesn't hurt anymore.
